label: The setup required time
subgoals: Locate the next capturing edge one period after launch

label: Setup slack
subgoals: Sum launch latency, clock-to-Q and the longest logic delay
Subtract that arrival from the setup required time
Read a negative result as a setup violation

label: Hold slack
subgoals: Sum launch latency, clock-to-Q and the shortest logic delay
Subtract the capture latency plus hold time
Explain why the clock period cancels from the hold check
